author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Anthropic launched a set of Claude tools for financial advisers on Monday, connecting the chatbot with investment analytics and wealth-management software, Reuters reported.

The product, called Claude for Financial Advisors, is designed to help firms prepare for client meetings, review portfolios and handle follow-up work. Anthropic said the offering connects with platforms and services from companies including BlackRock, Charles Schwab and Addepar.

Reuters reported that the tool also works with Envestnet, iCapital, Orion, Wealthbox, Wealth.com and Zocks. The launch follows OpenAI’s release of a version of ChatGPT aimed at investment bankers and equity researchers.

Anthropic’s expansion into financial services reflects the growing effort by AI companies to turn general-purpose chatbots into specialized workplace software. Financial firms are likely to evaluate the tools alongside existing compliance, privacy and human-review requirements.

The announcement arrives as investors and technology leaders debate the cost, pace and safety of frontier-AI development. Anthropic is presenting the financial-adviser product as a productivity tool for professional workflows rather than a replacement for licensed advice.
dek: Anthropic introduced a version of Claude that connects with investment analytics and wealth-management software used by financial firms.
headline: Anthropic launches Claude tools for financial advisers
